issues.description: The script rewrites the current YouTube video URL to a third-party domain (saveanyyoutube.com) and opens it in a new tab when the user clicks the download button. This transmits the current video URL (which may include user-specific parameters) to an external service.
issues.location: createDownloadButton() function, download button click handler
issues.recommendation: Clearly inform users that clicking the download button will send the current video URL to a third-party service. Consider privacy implications if the URL contains sensitive information.

issues.description: The script requests @connect permission for www.ssyoutube.com, but the code only uses saveanyyoutube.com for download redirection. No actual GM_xmlhttpRequest or network request to www.ssyoutube.com is present.
issues.recommendation: Remove unnecessary @connect permissions to minimize attack surface.

issues.description: The script uses @require to load SweetAlert2 from jsdelivr CDN without a fixed version hash. While the version is pinned (v11), CDN-based supply chain attacks are possible if the CDN is compromised.
issues.recommendation: Consider using a fixed hash or self-hosting trusted libraries to mitigate supply chain risks.
